title: Forest Enchantress
prompt: A beautiful young woman with fair skin and long flowing wavy brown hair stands in the center of a magical sunlit forest, wearing an intricate fantasy gown made of sheer layered emerald green, teal, and iridescent fabric that clings to her body, heavily adorned with living vines, colorful wildflowers, and leaves.
